name: Skateboard

tagline: A playful wall-mounted object that brings movement to the room.
cardDescription: A playful detail that brings movement and personality to the room.

name: Yellow Chair

cardDescription: A bright, comfortable accent against the room's darker palette.

material: Upholstered seat with a structured base
features: Works in living rooms and bedrooms

cardDescription: Graphic art that adds a warm visual focal point.

material: Printed artwork in a dark frame
